qualityModel.dispersion: Median absolute deviation (MAD) of successful latency samples; robust to isolated latency spikes
qualityModel.stableRule: Wilson lower bound >= 0.65 and every configured target succeeded at least once
qualityModel.workingRule: Beta-smoothed success rate >= 0.60, Wilson lower bound >= 0.30, and every configured target succeeded at least once
